summary: Master Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory Transformation through practical assessment, IIoT, dashboards, and roadmap planning. Enquire now.
lede: Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory Transformation shows professionals how to connect operational technology, IT, data, and automation into a production system that can sense, analyze, and respond in near real time. The course covers factory maturity assessment, smart factory roadmapping, IIoT connectivity, manufacturing dashboards, automation prioritization, and digital twin use-case selection. You will learn to link plant metrics with maintenance workflows, capital planning, and executive reporting while working with mixed legacy assets and budget constraints. Practical exercises include readiness scoring, dashboard wireframing, and roadmap building, with overview-level guidance on AI-assisted anomaly detection and OT cybersecurity governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with plant operations, automation, maintenance, quality, or industrial data and need to translate factory modernization into practical actions.
modules: Industrial IoT Connectivity and Data Flow
Digital Twin and AI Use Cases
Smart Factory Roadmap and Business Case
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a working knowledge of manufacturing operations, and examples of plant KPIs or process maps if available. No programming or data science background is required, but comfort with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic automation terminology will help you get more from the workshops.
